items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: The name 'Theresa Wilson' is mentioned by the interviewer as a label or identifier, but the interviewee (Isidore Barbarin) does not mention her, respond to her name, or describe any personal interaction.

ctx.x: That van had a van. That van had a van, boy. Could we get your name on the table? We'd like to have it. What would be the call? We could have your full name too. Yes. Your married name.
Theresa Wilson. Yeah. How many brothers did you have with Paul all together? We have four of us. Four brothers. Four brothers and one sister? No.
